tips: Through EPP feature, customers will be able to install JOD credit card transactions wither Online or POS transactions.
1- Customers will be able to install eligible transactions and view installment history online from Mobile Application.
2- Eligible transactions will only be displayed ( Online and POS).
3- JOD credit card transactions can be installed online via Mobile Application.
4- Installments tenor are 3,6,9,12,24,36 months with their relevant interest rates.
5- Eligible transactions will be displayed before cycle date of each month (24th).
6- Installed transactions cannot be fully paid at once through mobile application, customer needs to refer to call center agents.
7- Installment request successfully sent cannot be canceled / deleted through mobile application, customer needs to refer to call center agents.
